segments.rendered_text: Jen: So a few years ago, we were building what we thought was gonna be our next big game. Youth suicide is up 62%, and nearly every Gen A child is gaming. as builders, as parents, as believers, it broke our hearts knowing this place where the kids are spending the most time is where they're the most exposed, exploited, and hunted. So we pulled the chat out of our game so that we could solve the real problem, and this led to the creation of Haiven. So we are a protective chat and gaming platform that detects toxicity, predators, and mental health risk, and actually intervenes. So we don't just block the harm, we actually guide behavior through our vibe score system and other really fantastic gamification methods that leads to a safer, healthier gaming culture. We have 150 indie game developers waiting to launch on Haiven.
